fields.Name: T289 - Integrations Add Connection Wizard
fields.Description: Exercises the 3-step inline wizard flow (OpenWizard/WIZARD_STEPS/step-indicator + FilteredIntegrations search) which replaces the card grid — a code path entirely separate from generic entity create/grid.

InputDefinition.goal: Open the application switcher dropdown next to the logo and scroll the full list to find and open the Integrations application, then open its 'Integrations' (Connections) section. Click the 'Add Integration' button (top-right) or the dashed '+ Add Integration' card. Verify an inline multi-step wizard opens showing a step indicator with 'Choose Integration', 'Configure', and 'Test' steps, and that Step 1 shows a 'Search integrations...' box above a grid of integration definition cards (or a clear 'No integrations configured' message). Type a few letters in the search box and confirm the picker grid narrows or shows a no-match message. Seeing the wizard with its step indicator and a responsive Step 1 search is success — you do NOT need to complete the wizard. Pages can take 10-30s to load in this resource-constrained environment — wait, don't navigate away.

judgeValidationCriteria: The Add Integration wizard opens inline with a step indicator listing Choose Integration, Configure, and Test
Step 1 shows a search box and an integration picker grid OR a clear 'no integrations configured' state
Typing in the search box narrows the picker grid or shows a no-match message
No error messages, blank screens, or crash pages
